objective: Improve the search quality and ranking readiness of 42 independently positioned tenant domains without creating doorway pages, scaled low-value content or visually duplicated sites.

productionBaseline.deepSeoAndInternalLinkAudit: 41/42 passed the expanded source-link gate. The only failure was the production USFans guide, whose missing official source link is fixed locally in this change set.
productionBaseline.homepageDuplicateCheck: Maximum five-word shingle similarity was 0.563549 for eastmallbuyindex.com and hoobuyindex.net; no pair reached the 0.60 release threshold.
productionBaseline.externalLinkObservations: Eight official sites returned bot-blocking HTTP 403 to the audit client. KameyMall returned an inconclusive upstream 502. No reviewed internal link or definitively checked official source link returned 404 or 410.

localFixes: Added a nofollow official USFans verification link and an explicit independent-site FAQ disclosure to the USFans source-check guide.
Separated official header wordmarks from Google-facing square favicons for CNShopper, JoyaGoo and Sugargoo.
Added source-backed square favicon assets: CNShopper 2363x2363 PNG, JoyaGoo 64x64 PNG and Sugargoo 48x48 PNG.
Added a regression test that fails when any tenant favicon is missing, smaller than 8x8 or non-square.

Expanded the tenant production auditor to recurse child sitemaps, inspect every approved page, verify self-canonicals, robots, structured data, internal links, redirects, favicon delivery, the configured WhatsApp number and official source-link availability.

localAcceptance.eslint: passed for all changed TypeScript and TSX files
localAcceptance.productionBuild: passed; all 48 application static routes generated
localAcceptance.faviconGate: 42/42 tenant favicon files passed the square and minimum-size check
localAcceptance.usfansDesktopAndMobile: passed local visual review with source-backed logo, official verification action, responsive content and no invented hero image

releaseGate.commit: approved by the owner after local acceptance
releaseGate.push: approved for the current release branch
releaseGate.deployment: approved for a rollback-safe Hostinger release
releaseGate.nextRequiredStep: Commit only the relevant project files and three new favicon assets, deploy one Hostinger release, then rerun the 42-domain and 305-page production acceptance checks.
